notes.title: Remote Play Together Fest Demo
notes.notes:
In celebration of Steam's Remote Play Together Fest, we're releasing our first public demo in almost a year! In Quick Play, you can play as 8 different teams against a computer or human opponent, either locally or via Remote Play Together.

We're also introducing our brand new roguelike Career mode! Start with a team of just a single baby bird and improve your team between matches by training, drafting dice, and hatching new athletes!

The game is mostly feature complete and mainly needs more polishing and additional content. Please excuse the placeholder menu screens and lack of proper sound effects.

Any feedback you have on what you love and hate about the game is greatly appreciated! You can help make Dicey Birdball become the best bird-based strategy sports game on the market!

Thanks for reading, playing, and following along :)
